messages:
maya: Quick note 1: planning a short community workshop + refapp launch next Wed. Need: blog post, 2-line benchmark blurb, webinar ops, and inbound routing. Who can pick up copy + social?
jordan: I27ll own the repo + demo. Will add a one-click Docker quickstart and a 5-step tutorial. Target: repo ready Fri EOD.
sam: I27ll draft the blog post and social snippets. Can someone paste benchmark highlights? 1-paragraph and a 2-line blurb please.
igor: Paste: Llama2-13B (4-bit) on p4d; median decode ~45ms/token at batch=8; effective cost ~ $0.003/token after batching+kernel-opt; KV prefix cache reduced token spend ~22% in our tests.
maya: Nice. Sam 0: mirror that into a conservative blurb: "Batching + KV caching cut per-token spend ~2.2x and reduced p95 latency ~28% (test rig details in appendix)." Keep language careful.
anya: Inbound: attendees who fork the repo -> AE queue "community-inbound" in SFDC. Non-attenders -> 30d nurture list. Add hidden refapp=true on reg form.
registrations-bot: Current regs: 18. Link: https://redwood.ai/webinar-register?utm_source=community&utm_campaign=refapp_workshop
maya: Timeline: Fri EOD repo + demo video; Mon draft post + slides; Wed workshop; Thu publish post + social. Everyone ok? :thumbsup:
jordan: OK. Will upload demo video (~6m) and README updates by Fri.
